Invoiceable.title: Boolean update value
Invoiceable.description: Whether the company is invoiceable or not (or `null` if the `Invoiceable` field should not be updated).

AddFeesToInvoices.title: Boolean update value
AddFeesToInvoices.description: Whether the company has an additional fee applied for invoicing or not (or `null` if the `AddFeesToInvoices` field should not be updated).

AddTaxDeductedPaymentToInvoices.title: Boolean update value
AddTaxDeductedPaymentToInvoices.description: Whether tax-deducted payments should be automatically added to invoices (or `null` if the `AddTaxDeductedPaymentToInvoices` field should not be updated).
